none: PAS DENO-997F10: Roman coin: contemporary copy of a nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete copper-alloy contemporary copy of a copper-alloy Roman nummus of the House of Constantine (AD 307-361), dating to the period AD 330-335 (Reece Period 17). Victory on prow [CONSTANTINOPOLIS] reverse type. Copying uncertain mint. This coin is a mule. The obverse shows the bust of Roma and has the inscription VRBS ROMA, but the reverse shows Victory on prow, the Constantinopolis reverse type
